_comment: Perk icons the official EN wiki gets wrong, keyed "role/slug". Two mechanisms, because there are two different failures. "sources" points a slug at a replacement image URL, which scrape-perks.ts downloads and processes exactly like any scraped icon — use it when a correct icon exists somewhere else (normally deadbydaylight.wiki.gg). "pinned" instead marks a slug as never-re-download, treating whatever is already on disk as authoritative forever — use it only when the icon was placed by hand and has no fetchable source, since downloadIcon() would otherwise overwrite it on the next scheduled scrape.
